vulnerability_cn: 卖出时销毁池内代币并过早同步储备
vulnerability_en: Pair-balance burn and premature reserve synchronization during a sell
detail_cn: CRC 的卖出分支先收手续费，再烧毁 pair 已有 CRC 并 sync，最后才记入卖方转来的净额。历史回执显示 40,629.6 CRC 被烧毁，同步时池内仅余 0.0000000001 CRC，随后入账的本金使真实余额高于缓存储备，支持大额 USDT 输出。实际原始交易复算 pair 净流出 209,061.632267871026055744 USDT，EOA 净流入 201,359.472267252045095696 USDT；源表约 201,400 美元单列。未把第三方复现数字当成原始交易，未取得完整内部跟踪或独立复现。源表为 7 月 17 日，交易为 7 月 16 日 UTC。
detail_en: CRC takes a sell fee, burns CRC already held by the pair and calls sync before crediting the seller's net principal. The historical receipt records a 40,629.6 CRC burn leaving 0.0000000001 CRC during synchronization; the later principal credit creates a gap between real balance and cached reserve that enables excessive USDT output. The actual receipt reconciles to 209,061.632267871026055744 USDT net pair outflow and 201,359.472267252045095696 USDT net EOA inflow; the sheet's approximate USD 201,400 is kept separately. Third-party reproduction figures are not treated as historical transaction data. Full internal traces and an independent replay were not obtained. The sheet date is July 17 and the transaction date is July 16 UTC.
loss_scope: Approximate source-sheet attacker-loss estimate, distinct from the measured pool net outflow and measured EOA inflow.
